title: Carrier damage report: INV-1503 (PO-5503)
content:
Consignee: Fennick Medical Supply. Delivered 2026-10-10. Carrier pro number 448210.
Item: GWN-ISO-L, isolation gown L, case. Delivered: 400 cases.
Exception: 40 cases water damaged in transit; cartons soaked, contents unusable. Damage noted on the delivery receipt and confirmed by the carrier's inspector on 2026-10-12.
The other 360 cases were received in good condition.
